definitions.FUNDING_GAP_GT_3600S: Dv34 sent a qualifying transfer (>=0.01 SOL) to the creator before migration, but the gap between the transfer and migration exceeded the calibrated 3600-second HIGH-confidence threshold. Median failing gap ~36 hours; range 3843s to ~133 days.
definitions.DIRECT_EDGE_NOT_PROJECTED_LOST_RECENCY_T: Dv34's transfer met amount+gap thresholds, but a DIFFERENT funder's qualifying transfer to the same creator was temporally closer to migration, so the pipeline's one-edge-per-mint materialization attributed the mint to that other funder instead. Verified individually for all 6 -- Dv34 never wins this tie-break for any of them. This reflects genuine multi-funder co-funding, not evidence loss.
definitions.OUTSIDE_DISCOVERY_INPUT_POPULATION: Creator has no migration-verified launch (no token_analysis row joined to pumpfun_migration_verification) -- outside the discovery pipeline's source population entirely.
definitions.CREATOR_FUNDERS_ONLY_NO_TRANSFER_INDEX_R: A creator_funders relationship row exists (some earlier/different extraction process recorded a Dv34-to-creator funding relationship) but no corresponding normalized transfer_index row exists for it -- the relationship exists in an older/coarser evidence table but was never captured by the current transfer-indexing pipeline.

part7_low_is_not_wrong.reasoning: The 76 FUNDING_GAP_GT_3600S members are NOT classified as false or wrong. Each has a real, signature-bound transfer_index row from Dv34 to the creator, before migration, meeting the amount threshold -- only the timing gap exceeds the calibrated HIGH-confidence window. This is CREATE_CREATOR funding evidence (the relationship this whole Dv34 investigation concerns), correctly kept separate from B2Z's MIGRATION_SIGNER calibration (0/10 LOW-tier positive under a DIFFERENT role/contract). No conflation occurred here.

part8_main_db_funding_transaction_covera.finding: 105 of 123 (85%) already have signature-bound, normalized transfer_index evidence. This is NOT a coverage/join gap in the new pipeline -- it correctly reads and uses this same transfer_index table (see part9 funnel). The reduction to 23 is a legitimate confidence-tier filter (amount+gap+recency-tiebreak), not a failure to consume available signature-bound evidence.

part9_discovery_funnel.summary: 123 -> 116 (migration-verified) -> 105 (has transfer_index row) -> 29 (amount+gap thresholds met) -> 23 (wins recency tie-break) -> 23 (no extraction failure)

part10_classification_of_the_difference.quantitative_support: 76/100 (76%) of the difference is the calibrated 3600s HIGH-confidence gap threshold correctly excluding older/looser-timed funding relationships. 6/100 (6%) is a legitimate multi-funder recency tie-break, not evidence loss. 18/100 (18%) is genuinely outside the discovery pipeline's evidence base (no migration-verified launch or no transfer_index row) -- these represent a coarser/older evidence layer (creator_funders alone) than the pipeline consumes. NO PROJECTION_JOIN_GAP and NO NEW_PIPELINE_BUG were found: the pipeline's actual production function was re-executed live and correctly reproduced the exact committed 23-member set.
part10_classification_of_the_difference.note_on_initial_manual_replay_error: An initial hand-written SQL replay of the pipeline's logic (not calling the real function) produced 29 instead of 23, which looked like a possible bug. Re-running the ACTUAL production function (not a manual replay) proved the real pipeline is correct; the hand-replay had incorrectly pre-filtered to source=Dv34 before the cross-funder most-recent-per-mint dedup step, which bypasses the tie-break the real pipeline performs. This is documented so the investigation process itself is transparent, not just the conclusion.

part11_local_upgradability.reasoning: No member can be locally upgraded to HIGH confidence without weakening the calibrated 3600s/amount thresholds, which this milestone is explicitly prohibited from doing. The 82 VALID_HISTORICAL_ASSOCIATION_BUT_NOT_HIGH_QUALIFIED members already have all locally-available evidence attached (signature, amount, timestamp) -- there is nothing further to discover locally; their gap is a real temporal fact, not a data-completeness gap. RPC would not resolve this either (RPC would confirm the SAME already-known transfer, not close the timing gap). The 18 historical-only members lack transfer_index rows entirely; closing that would require re-running the transfer-indexing extraction against archived RPC data, which is a DIFFERENT kind of work (backfill/indexing) not selective single-edge verification, and is out of scope for this milestone.

verdict_reasoning: Every one of the 123 real main-DB Dv34 relationship members has a fully evidence-backed classification.
